paragraphs.text: 1. SAVITAR, golden-haired, hath lifted eastward, bright With the sunbeams, his eternal lustre;
He in whose energy wise Pusan marches, surveying all existence like a herdsman.
paragraphs.original: तस्य पूषा प्रसवे याति विद्वान्सम्पश्यन्विश्वा भुवनानि गोपाः
paragraphs.translit: tasya pūṣā prasave yāti vidvānsampaśyanviśvā bhuvanāni gopāḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. Beholding men he sits amid the heaven filling the two world-halves and air's wide region.
paragraphs.original: नृचक्षा एष दिवो मध्य आस्त आपप्रिवान्रोदसी अन्तरिक्षम् ।
paragraphs.translit: nṛcakṣā eṣa divo madhya āsta āpaprivānrodasī antarikṣam |

paragraphs.text: He looks upon the rich far-spreading pastures between the eastern and the western limit.
paragraphs.original: स विश्वाचीरभि चष्टे घृताचीरन्तरा पूर्वमपरं च केतुम्
paragraphs.translit: sa viśvācīrabhi caṣṭe ghṛtācīrantarā pūrvamaparaṃ ca ketum

paragraphs.text: 3. He, root of wealth, the gatherer-up of treasures, looks with his might on every form and figure.
paragraphs.original: रायो बुध्नः संगमनो वसूनां विश्वा रूपाभि चष्टे शचीभिः ।
paragraphs.translit: rāyo budhnaḥ saṃgamano vasūnāṃ viśvā rūpābhi caṣṭe śacībhiḥ |

paragraphs.text: Savitar, like a God whose Law is constant, stands in the battle for the spoil like Indra.
paragraphs.original: देव इव सविता सत्यधर्मेन्द्रो न तस्थौ समरे धनानाम्
paragraphs.translit: deva iva savitā satyadharmendro na tasthau samare dhanānām

paragraphs.text: 4. Waters from sacrifice came to the Gandharva Visvavasu, O Soma, when they saw him.
Indra, approaching quickly, marked their going, and looked around upon the Sun's enclosures.
paragraphs.original: तदन्ववैदिन्द्रो रारहाण आसां परि सूर्यस्य परिधीँरपश्यत्
paragraphs.translit: tadanvavaidindro rārahāṇa āsāṃ pari sūryasya paridhīm̐rapaśyat

paragraphs.text: 5. This song Visvavasu shall sing us, meter of air's mid-realm celestial Gandharva,
paragraphs.original: विश्वावसुरभि तन्नो गृणातु दिव्यो गन्धर्वो रजसो विमानः ।
paragraphs.translit: viśvāvasurabhi tanno gṛṇātu divyo gandharvo rajaso vimānaḥ |

paragraphs.text: That we may know aright both truth and falsehood: may he inspire our thoughts and help our praises.
paragraphs.original: यद्वा घा सत्यमुत यन्न विद्म धियो हिन्वानो धिय इन्नो अव्याः
paragraphs.translit: yadvā ghā satyamuta yanna vidma dhiyo hinvāno dhiya inno avyāḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. In the floods' track he found the booty seeker: the rocky cow-pen's doors he threw wide open.
These, the Gandharva told him, Rowed with Amrta. Indra knew well the puissance of the dragons.
paragraphs.original: प्रासां गन्धर्वो अमृतानि वोचदिन्द्रो दक्षं परि जानादहीनाम्
paragraphs.translit: prāsāṃ gandharvo amṛtāni vocadindro dakṣaṃ pari jānādahīnām
